name: Banagher Links
source:
From: Mobile Suit Gundam NT (Narrative)
Member of the Garencieres Team. The former pilot of Singularity One (the Unicorn Gundam), which is now locked away. He pilots the Silver Bullet Suppressor, and supported Jona in his battle with Zoltan.
